title: Resolution 1 of the 13th CGPM (1967): SI unit of time
authors: General Conference on Weights and Measures
lineage: Paraphrased notes on inspected passages; no full source reproduction.

passages.locator: Selected catalogue description, abstract, resolution or historical passage
passages.note: The 13th CGPM replaced the previous SI second definition with a caesium-133 atomic-transition definition of 9,192,631,770 periods. It records a standard-setting decision, not adoption of a single 1955 NPL instrument.
